body:
Founder reported 'i have 2 gens same elo seems wrong' after S459-60's reordering fix was already live. Root issue: _run_evaluation_match returned a silent 0.5 for both a genuine 0-0 tie and a crashed/unreadable bot report, indistinguishable in the log; the two eval-opponent frozen_policy_bot.py processes ran with stdout/stderr fully silenced (DEVNULL), so a real crash's traceback was invisible. Fixed: captures each bot's real output to a log file, prints kill counts on success or the captured crash output on failure. Live-verified via a real local 2-generation run: real decisive kill counts logged (main_gen1.zip kills=12 vs main_gen0.zip kills=8), Elo correctly moved 1500->1516/1484 for all 3 roles, confirming both S459-60's fix and this diagnostic work together. Full python -m unittest suite (35 tests) green. Commit 164eb53.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-61: added real diagnostics to distinguish genuine Elo ties from silent evaluation-match crashes
